blocks.text: One point on the second item in Richard's note, the list of patents your engineers already know of. Please have it sent to Richard or to me, and ask the engineers at {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} not to discuss those patents with each other by email.

An engineer's views on a third-party patent are not privileged unless they are given to counsel. Written comments of that kind can be produced in litigation and read as knowledge of the patent. A bare list of numbers or owner names carries none of that risk.
If an engineer has a concern about a particular patent, the place for it is the call Richard has asked for, with one of us on the line.
